name: Healing Helps
verdict: Paid channels (Meta and Google Ads) recorded zero spend and zero leads over the past 28 days, so organic Google Business Profile activity is carrying all engagement with 27 total actions including 2 calls, 14 direction requests, and 11 website clicks. The biggest movement is a 50% week-over-week lift in GBP actions, likely driven by increased local search visibility or seasonal demand, while Search Console and GA4 traffic each declined roughly 41% in the same period, suggesting the site itself may need attention.

performance.verdict: Organic GBP rising but paid is absent; site traffic collapsing.

findings.text: Zero paid spend across all 28 days — Meta and Google Ads both show $0 — meaning 100% of engagement falls on organic alone.
SC clicks fell 41.67% week-over-week; last 3 days (Sep 8–10) show 2, 0, 0 vs prior 3 days (Sep 5–7) at 1, 1, 1 — sustained organic search decay.
GA4 sessions down 41.27% week-over-week; last 3 days average 6 vs prior 3-day average of 4.7, but the Sep 1 spike of 28 sessions inflates the prior window, masking real weakness.
GBP actions up 50% week-over-week (27 total over 28 days: 2 calls, 14 directions, 11 web clicks) while paid is dark — local intent exists but no paid channel is capturing it.
GHL pipeline shows null — 0 leads recorded in 28 days means no pipeline data to evaluate; intake workflow status is unknown.

suggestions.text: Confirm whether paid channels are intentionally paused or dark by error before any budget move.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta and Google Ads show $0 spend across all 28 days — this is either a deliberate pause or a configuration error. Sohib to confirm with client whether campaigns are intentionally off. If unintentional, reactivation is the priority action. Re-check on 2026-09-14 to confirm status.

suggestions.text: Monitor SC clicks and GA4 sessions over next 3 days; 0, 0 close on SC is a confirmed decay signal.
suggestions.monday_update: Search Console clicks posted 0 on both Sep 9 and Sep 10, and GA4 is down 41.27% week-over-week. This is a 3-day confirmed decay signal on organic search, not noise. Watch whether sessions recover above the recent 5–7/day baseline by Sep 14. If not, a site or GSC technical audit is warranted.

suggestions.text: Verify GHL pipeline is connected and receiving leads; null pipeline with 27 GBP actions signals a possible intake gap.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP recorded 27 actions including 2 calls and 11 website clicks over 28 days, yet GHL shows null pipeline with zero opportunities. This suggests either the intake form or CRM connection is broken, or those contacts are not being routed into GHL at all. Confirm GHL webhook or form embed is live by Sep 14 to determine if inbound intent is being lost.
